title: mentha arvensis var. legitima
intro: Mentha arvensis var. legitima, commonly known as American wild mint, is a variety of the mint plant species. It is a perennial herb that grows in wet environments and is native to North America. The health benefits of American wild mint include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues, reduce stress, and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of American wild mint include menthone, isomenthone, and menthol, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-emetic, and anti-spasmodic properties.
